name: jev
description: Jev picks the tool that fits Claude's next step and Claude gets it as a hint, shown live and measured against a control group. Native to Claude Code: no gateway, no proxy.

mode.title: Jev: hints
mode.description: on: before Claude's requests, Jev's confident tool picks reach Claude as a hint. off: no hints.

controlPercent.title: Jev: control group (%)
controlPercent.description: This share of turns runs with no Jev feature at all, the baseline the /jev board measures every saving against. 0 turns it off (and the board cannot measure hints or effort).

doneCheck.title: Jev: done check
doneCheck.description: on: when Claude stops after promising more work, with nothing running and nothing asked of you, it is sent back to work (once per turn). off: never checked.

effort.title: Jev: effort
effort.description: on: quick status questions (is it deployed, are we done) run at low effort, on the same model, back to your effort if the turn grows. off: your effort always.

skillGate.title: Jev: skill gate
skillGate.description: on: at session start Jev judges which skills this project needs; the others keep only their name in the list Claude reads on every request (still callable). off: the full list.

freshStart.title: Jev: fresh start
freshStart.description: on: when a prompt starts a new task that needs nothing from a long conversation, Jev offers /clear or /compact before sending it. off: never asks.

excludedRepos.title: Jev: excluded repos
excludedRepos.description: Comma-separated folder names. Sessions in these folders never ask Jev, so their conversations are not sent to it, and their prompts stay out of the log.
